title: Deer Grunt Tube (5-part telescoping kit)
description: Reed grunt tube: mouth barrel with tone insert and reed, plus a slide-over extension tube that changes pitch as you telescope it.
material: PETG, 0.16-0.2 mm layers; reed from 0.2 mm PET film.
assembly: 1-3. Seat the tone insert, lay the reed on the deck, press in the clamp wedge (see reed-call steps).
4. Slide the extension tube over the barrel exit end (slide-fit, 0.25 mm radial play). Pull out to lower pitch, push in to raise it.
5. Blow short grunt-like breaths; tune with reed length / wedge position.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
